diagnostics.message: Many higher-level assembly objects (e.g., CoffeeMachine2/CoffeeMachine/Case/Front/Outlet, UserInterfaceElements groups) have no renderer bounds (empty worldAabb/size). Only leaf meshes provide geometry data.

Several buttons under CoffeeButtons and WaterButtons have no colliders; only MenuButtons (ButtonOnOff/OK/Up/Down) are explicitly collidable. Interaction may be incomplete unless colliders are added or handled via raycast/mesh.
Functional links between UI buttons and coffee/steam simulations are not explicitly defined in provided JSON; any controls/relations were added with low confidence based on names only.

Interaction type mapping was only provided for CoffeeMachine2 (device-level). Individual button interactionParams.type fields are empty in JSON; press behavior inferred only where colliders exist or roles indicate Button.
